LAMMPS_COEFF_BEFORE_STYLE.rationale: bond_coeff/angle_coeff/dihedral_coeff/improper_coeff/pair_coeff assign parameters to the style set by the matching *_style command; LAMMPS aborts with 'X_coeff command before X_style is defined' when the coeff appears first (observed live 2026-10-21: bond_coeff without bond_style, input.cpp:1395). Skipped for read_restart inputs because restart files restore force-field styles
LAMMPS_COEFF_BEFORE_STYLE.severity_meaning: ERROR findings cause L1 FAIL; the input cannot pass static validation
LAMMPS_COEFF_BEFORE_STYLE.source_reference: SKILL.md Validation Rules table; validate_input.py validate_lammps() coeff-before-style branch
LAMMPS_COEFF_BEFORE_STYLE.trigger_condition: a *_coeff command appears with no earlier declaration of its matching *_style in the linearized command stream (includes expanded; cleared by `clear`)

LAMMPS_DATA_UNREADABLE.rationale: A read_data or read_restart file that cannot be read means LAMMPS cannot load the system; every physical command after it is meaningless
LAMMPS_DATA_UNREADABLE.severity_meaning: WARN findings do not block L1 PASS but must be reported to the user
LAMMPS_DATA_UNREADABLE.source_reference: SKILL.md Validation Rules table; validate_input.py validate_lammps() read_data/read_restart branch
LAMMPS_DATA_UNREADABLE.trigger_condition: the data file referenced by read_data/read_restart is missing or unreadable

LAMMPS_EAM_PAIRCOEFF_ARGS.rationale: funcfl-format potentials are single-element files used with pair_style eam; setfl-format files are multi-element and must be paired with eam/alloy or eam/fs. Mixing formats makes the pair_coeff argument list wrong and LAMMPS will reject or misread the potential
LAMMPS_EAM_PAIRCOEFF_ARGS.severity_meaning: ERROR findings cause L1 FAIL; the input cannot pass static validation
LAMMPS_EAM_PAIRCOEFF_ARGS.source_reference: SKILL.md Validation Rules table; validate_input.py validate_lammps() eam pair_coeff branch
LAMMPS_EAM_PAIRCOEFF_ARGS.trigger_condition: pair_style eam/eam/alloy/eam/fs present but pair_coeff argument count is incompatible with the potential file format

LAMMPS_ELECTRODE_KSPACE.rationale: Constant-potential electrode fixes (fix electrode/*) require the /electrode variants of the kspace styles (pppm/electrode or ewald/electrode); plain pppm/ewald crashes because the electrode solver needs a charge-solver hook that the plain styles do not provide
LAMMPS_ELECTRODE_KSPACE.severity_meaning: ERROR findings cause L1 FAIL; the input cannot pass static validation
LAMMPS_ELECTRODE_KSPACE.source_reference: SKILL.md Validation Rules table; validate_input.py validate_lammps() electrode kspace branch
LAMMPS_ELECTRODE_KSPACE.trigger_condition: fix electrode/* present without pppm/electrode or ewald/electrode as the kspace style

LAMMPS_MLFF_NO_MODEL.rationale: Machine-learning force fields (mace/deepmd/pace) require a model file with the trained parameters; without a model file there are no parameters and LAMMPS cannot compute forces
LAMMPS_MLFF_NO_MODEL.severity_meaning: WARN findings do not block L1 PASS but must be reported to the user
LAMMPS_MLFF_NO_MODEL.source_reference: SKILL.md Validation Rules table; validate_input.py validate_lammps() mlff pair_style branch
LAMMPS_MLFF_NO_MODEL.trigger_condition: pair_style mace/deepmd/pace present without a model file or an explicit unresolved placeholder marker

LAMMPS_NEB_NO_FIX.rationale: The neb command requires an accompanying fix with the neb style to define the spring and replica force; without it LAMMPS rejects the neb run
LAMMPS_NEB_NO_FIX.severity_meaning: ERROR findings cause L1 FAIL; the input cannot pass static validation
LAMMPS_NEB_NO_FIX.source_reference: SKILL.md Validation Rules table; validate_input.py validate_lammps() neb branch
LAMMPS_NEB_NO_FIX.trigger_condition: neb command present without a fix ... neb command in the input

LAMMPS_NO_ATOM_STYLE.rationale: LAMMPS requires atom_style before any system-defining command; without it the atom data layout is undefined and every pair/neighbor command is ambiguous
LAMMPS_NO_ATOM_STYLE.severity_meaning: ERROR findings cause L1 FAIL; the input cannot pass static validation
LAMMPS_NO_ATOM_STYLE.source_reference: SKILL.md Validation Rules table; validate_input.py validate_lammps() required-command loop
LAMMPS_NO_ATOM_STYLE.trigger_condition: atom_style command absent from the input script

LAMMPS_NO_BOUNDARY.rationale: LAMMPS requires an explicit boundary command; the default periodicity is not guaranteed and a vacuum-axis boundary mistake silently changes the simulation geometry
LAMMPS_NO_BOUNDARY.severity_meaning: ERROR findings cause L1 FAIL; the input cannot pass static validation
LAMMPS_NO_BOUNDARY.source_reference: SKILL.md Validation Rules table; validate_input.py validate_lammps() required-command loop
LAMMPS_NO_BOUNDARY.trigger_condition: boundary command absent from the input script

LAMMPS_NO_DUMP.rationale: An MD run without any dump produces no trajectory output; the simulation becomes unanalyzable for every downstream purpose
LAMMPS_NO_DUMP.severity_meaning: WARN findings do not block L1 PASS but must be reported to the user
LAMMPS_NO_DUMP.source_reference: SKILL.md Validation Rules table; validate_input.py validate_lammps() output branch
LAMMPS_NO_DUMP.trigger_condition: MD run present without any dump command in the input

LAMMPS_NO_PAIR_STYLE.rationale: LAMMPS requires pair_style before run/minimize; without it no interatomic forces can be computed and the run is meaningless
LAMMPS_NO_PAIR_STYLE.severity_meaning: ERROR findings cause L1 FAIL; the input cannot pass static validation
LAMMPS_NO_PAIR_STYLE.source_reference: SKILL.md Validation Rules table; validate_input.py validate_lammps() required-command loop
LAMMPS_NO_PAIR_STYLE.trigger_condition: pair_style command absent from the input script

LAMMPS_NO_RUN.rationale: A LAMMPS input must terminate in run, minimize or neb; without a run directive nothing is executed and the input is inert
LAMMPS_NO_RUN.severity_meaning: ERROR findings cause L1 FAIL; the input cannot pass static validation
LAMMPS_NO_RUN.source_reference: SKILL.md Validation Rules table; validate_input.py validate_lammps() required-command loop
LAMMPS_NO_RUN.trigger_condition: neither run nor minimize nor neb present in the input script

LAMMPS_NO_SHAKE.rationale: Explicit water with flexible bonds at a timestep above 1 fs requires a rigid constraint (fix shake or fix rigid); without it hydrogen motion is under-resolved and the integration is unstable
LAMMPS_NO_SHAKE.severity_meaning: WARN findings do not block L1 PASS but must be reported to the user
LAMMPS_NO_SHAKE.source_reference: SKILL.md Validation Rules table; validate_input.py validate_lammps() constraint branch
LAMMPS_NO_SHAKE.trigger_condition: water (H) present with a high timestep but no fix shake or fix rigid constraint

LAMMPS_NO_SYSTEM.rationale: LAMMPS requires a system definition (read_data, read_restart or create_box/create_atoms) before any physics; without atoms the simulation has nothing to simulate
LAMMPS_NO_SYSTEM.severity_meaning: ERROR findings cause L1 FAIL; the input cannot pass static validation
LAMMPS_NO_SYSTEM.source_reference: SKILL.md Validation Rules table; validate_input.py validate_lammps() required-command loop
LAMMPS_NO_SYSTEM.trigger_condition: no read_data, read_restart, create_box or create_atoms command present

LAMMPS_NO_THERMO.rationale: Without an explicit thermo command LAMMPS may use a silent default output frequency; thermodynamic state cannot be verified from the log
LAMMPS_NO_THERMO.severity_meaning: WARN findings do not block L1 PASS but must be reported to the user
LAMMPS_NO_THERMO.source_reference: SKILL.md Validation Rules table; validate_input.py validate_lammps() output branch
LAMMPS_NO_THERMO.trigger_condition: MD run present without any thermo output frequency command

LAMMPS_NO_UNITS.rationale: LAMMPS requires the units command before any physical command; without units, all subsequent numeric values are dimensionally ambiguous
LAMMPS_NO_UNITS.severity_meaning: ERROR findings cause L1 FAIL; the input cannot pass static validation
LAMMPS_NO_UNITS.source_reference: SKILL.md Validation Rules table; validate_input.py validate_lammps() required-command loop
LAMMPS_NO_UNITS.trigger_condition: units command absent from the input script

LAMMPS_NO_VELOCITY.rationale: An MD run without velocity initialization starts from zero velocity, which is usually not the intended thermal state; the first stage may be a spurious equilibration artifact
LAMMPS_NO_VELOCITY.severity_meaning: WARN findings do not block L1 PASS but must be reported to the user
LAMMPS_NO_VELOCITY.source_reference: SKILL.md Validation Rules table; validate_input.py validate_lammps() velocity branch
LAMMPS_NO_VELOCITY.trigger_condition: MD run present without a velocity command initializing atom velocities

LAMMPS_NPT_NONPERIODIC_DIM.rationale: A fix npt/nph barostat pressurizes a specified dimension; barostatting a non-periodic (fixed) boundary dimension makes LAMMPS error out or silently barostats the vacuum gap
LAMMPS_NPT_NONPERIODIC_DIM.severity_meaning: ERROR findings cause L1 FAIL; the input cannot pass static validation
LAMMPS_NPT_NONPERIODIC_DIM.source_reference: SKILL.md Validation Rules table; validate_input.py validate_lammps() barostat branch
LAMMPS_NPT_NONPERIODIC_DIM.trigger_condition: fix npt/nph pressurizes a dimension whose boundary flag is not periodic

LAMMPS_NVT_NVE_CONFLICT.rationale: A group can carry at most one active time integrator; stacking nve/nvt/npt/nph/rigid on the same group without unfix separation leaves the integration state ambiguous
LAMMPS_NVT_NVE_CONFLICT.severity_meaning: ERROR findings cause L1 FAIL; the input cannot pass static validation
LAMMPS_NVT_NVE_CONFLICT.source_reference: SKILL.md Validation Rules table; validate_input.py validate_lammps() integrator branch
LAMMPS_NVT_NVE_CONFLICT.trigger_condition: the same group carries more than one active time integrator without unfix separation

LAMMPS_PAIR_COEFF_MISSING.rationale: pair_style without pair_coeff means no potential parameters are loaded; LAMMPS cannot compute forces
LAMMPS_PAIR_COEFF_MISSING.severity_meaning: ERROR findings cause L1 FAIL; the input cannot pass static validation
LAMMPS_PAIR_COEFF_MISSING.source_reference: SKILL.md Validation Rules table; validate_input.py validate_lammps() pair_coeff branch
LAMMPS_PAIR_COEFF_MISSING.trigger_condition: pair_style command present but no pair_coeff command in the input

LAMMPS_PLACEHOLDER_UNRESOLVED.trigger_condition: an active (non-comment) command line contains a >>> USER placeholder marker

LAMMPS_REAXC_REMOVED.severity_meaning: ERROR findings cause L1 FAIL; the input cannot pass static validation
LAMMPS_REAXC_REMOVED.source_reference: SKILL.md Validation Rules table; validate_input.py validate_lammps() pair_style branch
LAMMPS_REAXC_REMOVED.trigger_condition: pair_style reax/c present in the input

LAMMPS_TIMESTEP_HIGH.rationale: A timestep above 1 fs with hydrogen atoms (or 2 fs without) is unstable for the integration scheme; the trajectory will not conserve energy
LAMMPS_TIMESTEP_HIGH.severity_meaning: WARN findings do not block L1 PASS but must be reported to the user
LAMMPS_TIMESTEP_HIGH.source_reference: SKILL.md Validation Rules table; validate_input.py validate_lammps() timestep branch
LAMMPS_TIMESTEP_HIGH.trigger_condition: the timestep exceeds 1 fs when hydrogen is present, or 2 fs otherwise

LAMMPS_TIMESTEP_INVALID.rationale: A timestep value that is not a finite positive number is invalid; LAMMPS cannot integrate with it and the numeric parse is ambiguous
LAMMPS_TIMESTEP_INVALID.severity_meaning: ERROR findings cause L1 FAIL; the input cannot pass static validation
LAMMPS_TIMESTEP_INVALID.source_reference: SKILL.md Validation Rules table; validate_input.py validate_lammps() timestep branch
LAMMPS_TIMESTEP_INVALID.trigger_condition: timestep value is missing, non-numeric, non-finite or not positive

LAMMPS_VELOCITY_ZERO_TEMP.source_reference: SKILL.md Validation Rules table; validate_input.py validate_lammps() velocity branch
